text_excerpt: --> Research | Canine Cancer Alliance top of page Give in Honor & Memorial Donate Projects Canine Cancer Alliance accelerates the discovery of safer and much more effective treatments for dogs with cancer. ​ By funding research, supporting clinical trials, and empowering families with the latest findings, CCA is helping end dog cancer as we know it today. Prof. Mamula with Ranger who became cancer-free after his metastatic osteosarcoma was treated with the vaccine. ​ EGFR/HE R2 C anine Cancer Vaccine ​ A clinical trial is open at ten locations for canine patients with osteosarcoma, hemangiosarcoma and TCC which are cancer types often associated with EGFR/HER2 overexpression. See the status page to find out which clinics are participating in the study.
